title: Uposatha (2)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || pa || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacce jalābujā nāgā uposatham upavasanti ossaṭṭhakāya ca bhavantīti || || 4-6 Sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ || || 7 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacce jalābujā nāgā uposatham upavasanti ossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
